title: Cross-repo objective
objective: One episode spans two Repository subjects: work orders, commits and receipts must each bind to the correct per-repo current Subject, and the episode must still be admitted AUTONOMOUS with zero stale-subject receipts.

scenario_identity.identity_rule: sha256 over the canonical manifest bytes; per-trial corpus identity pinned by MANIFEST.json sha256

setup.loop: ALOOP-001 loop, but iteration i commits into repo[i % 2]; each receipt.persist binds subject = the CURRENT head of the repo it touched
setup.subject_rule: receipt for repo-A commits binds repo-A's current Subject; binding the other repo's head is a STALE_SUBJECT integrity failure

acceptance_criteria: both Repository objects appear as subject of at least one receipt
falsifier: Rebind one receipt's subject to the sibling repo's head: the court must report STALE_SUBJECT and the scenario verdict must flip to FAIL.

negative_control.name: stale cross-repo subject binding
negative_control.requirement: a receipt bound to a superseded Subject must fail the scenario

status_note: Synthetic corpus; second repository is a synthetic Subject stream, not a real checkout.
